name: PayPal Payments
description: Payment processing via PayPal. Supports one-time payments, subscriptions, and webhook handling.

dbTables.name: payments
dbTables.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT, paypal_order_id TEXT UNIQUE, paypal_payer_id TEXT, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, currency TEXT DEFAULT 'AUD', status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', description TEXT, metadata TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payments_user ON payments(user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payments_paypal ON payments(paypal_order_id)

dbTables.name: subscriptions
dbTables.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT, paypal_subscription_id TEXT UNIQUE, paypal_plan_id TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'active', current_period_start TEXT, current_period_end TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_subs_user ON subscriptions(user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_subs_paypal ON subscriptions(paypal_subscription_id)

webhooks.description: Process PayPal payment and subscription events
